finalAcceptance.activeBehaviorAccepted: package-parts keeps historical mascotBody hash encodings: omitted release body hashes as null; explicit Cursor remains cursor. Release r and written w are independent snapshots and need not be equal; for an omitted release body, the Store may write canonical Cursor, so r=null and w=cursor is expected and stable per side.
finalAcceptance.customProfileSensitivity: A fingerprint of mascotProfile is included only when the profile has saved shapes; changes to the shape catalog/profile affect the look part, while profiles without custom shapes retain the old hash shape.

finalAcceptance.migrationCaveat: Store startup intentionally migrates a bot lacking mascotProfile/body to canonical builtin Cursor and writes the legacy Cursor projection. A packageBase.w hash created before that migration may still encode an omitted body as null. No active packageBase update comparator was found in this checkout; this review does not claim every historical w hash equals its post-migration representation and adds no speculative comparator.
finalAcceptance.conclusion: Accepted against active behavior; no new finding.
